title: CPC-2025-5724-CU3
text:
CPC-2025-5724-CU3  Council District: 13 – Soto-Martinez
  CEQA: LA-Glendale Water Reclamation Plant MND  Last Day to Act: 10-08-26
  SCH. 201710169 and Addendum (April 2026)
  Plan Area: Northeast Los Angeles

  PUBLIC HEARING – Completed July 7, 2026

  PROJECT SITE:  4590 – 4610 and 4700 West Colorado Boulevard; 3901 East Goodwin Avenue

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  Demolition of an existing chlorine detention pond and associated improvements to allow for the construction
  of new wastewater treatment tanks and equipment, a new Personnel building, a new Advanced Water
  Purification Demonstration Facility ("AWPDF"), accessory structures, and landscaping improvements parallel
  to the adjacent Los Angeles River, as part of the Los Angeles - Glendale Water Reclamation Plan
  ("LAGWRP") campus. The proposed AWPDF would be up to 17 feet in height and 4,695 square feet of floor
  area and the proposed Personnel building would be up to 46 feet, 8 inches in height and 14,707 square feet
  of floor area.

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Based on the independent judgment of the decision-maker, after consideration of the whole of the
  administrative record, the Project was assessed in Mitigated Negative Declaration (MND) State
  Clearinghouse No. 2017101069 adopted May 2018; and pursuant to CEQA Guidelines 15162 and 15164,
  as supported by the Addendum dated April 2026, no major revisions are required to the MND; and no
  subsequent EIR or negative declaration is required for approval of the Project;
  2. Pursuant to Chapter 1 Section 12.24 U.21 and Chapter 1A Section 13B.2.3 of the Los Angeles Municipal
  Code (LAMC), a Class 3 Conditional Use Permit for:
  a. A Sewage Treatment Facility/Water Treatment Facility/Water Filtration Plant within the PF Zone; and
  b. An eight-foot-tall fence, pursuant to LAMC Section 13B.2.3.D.5.b, in lieu of the maximum six-foot-tall
  fence permitted in the RIO Inner Core per LAMC Section 13.17 F.2(a)(ii).

  Applicant:  City of Los Angeles Sanitation & Environment Department
  Representative: Jon Meyer, Craig Lawson & Co., LLC

  Staff:  Esther Ahn, City Planner
  esther.ahn@lacity.org
  (213) 978-1486
summary: Demolition of chlorine detention pond and construction of new wastewater treatment tanks, equipment, and Advanced Water Purification Demonstration Facility at 4590 West Colorado Boulevard as part of LA-Glendale Water Reclamation Plan campus.
